_comment: THE BUDGETS LEDGER (#915 Wave 4). One of four ledgers under tests/; every number here is DOWN-ONLY (a ceiling may fall freely; widening one needs a CHANGED approvedDeviation in ITS OWN section, never a neighbour's). Validated by `bun run lint:ledgers` and by `bun run test:ratchet`, both against the merge base with a fallback to the old file paths for the merge that created this file. Sections: `suiteWallClock` (the pr-vitest file-span sum and the rung-2 pr-gate elapsed clock), `rungs` (the ladder's p95 wall-clock budget per rung, read by scripts/ci/lane-rules.mjs), `designTokenCss` (deliberately empty; see docs/traps/design-tokens.md) and `mobileSuites` (a derived MIRROR of the roster's suite budgets). EVERY USER-FACING CEILING AND THE RIG REGISTER LEFT for tests/journeys.json (#927), which keys them by `surface / journey / volume / hardware` — this file keeps only the ceilings on the SUITE and the LADDER, which no journey owns. See TESTING.md 'The ledgers'.

suiteWallClock._comment: Suite wall-clock ceilings (#656 Layer 5). Tighten-only, ratcheted alongside the perf budgets in scripts/test-report/ratchet-floors.mjs. `budgetMs` is the sum of per-file durations in artifacts/test-results/vitest.json, not the run's elapsed time. SCORE IT ONLY ON A SINGLE-JOB, UNSHARDED RUN — candidate.yml enforces it on the `suite` lane (rung 3; it rode on ci.yml `verify` until #915's rung-2 ceiling measured that job at 24 min), and #905 is why it cannot be scored on the shards. This comment used to claim the sum was concurrency-invariant ('elapsed varies with host load and --concurrency, while the sum is the work the suite actually asked for'). It is not: the sum is of per-file WALL SPANS, and files inside a run execute concurrently, so every file's span stretches when workers timeshare a slow runner. Measured in #905 on one host, same 1508 files — 2,370.5s uninstrumented, 2,427.0s instrumented (+2.4%, so v8 coverage is NOT the variable) — against 3,824.0s from the four-way sharded `coverage` lane on a run whose shard 1 took 545s to main's 383s. Reseeded 2026-08-29 from CI verify (1487 files, 2,492.7s measured, 15% headroom → 2,867,000ms). Prior seed 2026-08-22: 1332 files, 2,018.1s, 2,321,000ms. Widening this number needs a top-level `approvedDeviation` saying what the extra time buys; `bun run test:suite-wall-clock -- --write` only ever lowers it. #915 added a SECOND lane with a DIFFERENT metric and the same tighten-only rule: `pr-gate` is the rung-2 gate's ELAPSED wall clock (max completed_at − min started_at across `check`'s needs jobs, read from the Actions API by scripts/ci/pr-gate-wall-clock.mjs in the `check` job), not a sum of file spans, and it is the ladder's rung-2 budget — 15 minutes, the number #915 sets as the price of a merge. It is not scored on `verify` and must not be: the two lanes measure different things and neither number may be substituted for the other. Both are ratcheted by scripts/test-report/ratchet-floors.mjs, which flattens every `budgetMs` in this file and fails a widen without a changed `approvedDeviation`.
suiteWallClock.approvedDeviation: #883 reseed after Grants v2 + platform consolidation: CI verify measured 2492.7s across 1487 files vs the #850 1332-file / 2018.1s seed (2321.0s ceiling, +474.6s). The extra time is the grant-plane, replica pushdown, fulfillment, ontology, and compact-band suites this umbrella added to the PR vitest lane — not runner variance. Ceiling set 15% above that CI measurement at 2,867,000ms. Mere presence of this field does not waive a later widen (#781).

rungs._comment: The ladder's wall-clock budget per rung, in milliseconds (#915). Lifted here from a literal in scripts/ci/lane-rules.mjs so the ladder's own numbers are ratcheted like every other budget: a rung budget may fall, and widening one is a reviewed edit with an approvedDeviation. Rung 0 (pre-commit, 5 s) and rung 1 (pre-push, 90 s) are enforced by the hooks and by the pre-push-gate directive, not from here.

designTokenCss._comment: DELIBERATELY EMPTY, and it stays that way. docs/traps/design-tokens.md forbids repopulating this ledger: scripts/lint-design-tokens.mjs accepts only a current --t-* role or size rung, so a raw hex or an arbitrary var() has no budget to hide in and a stale entry here is itself a failure. `budgets` is the map the linter reads; an entry is a debt with a number, and there are none.

mobileSuites._comment: DERIVED MIRROR of tests/agent-e2e-mobile/roster.json#suites[].budgetMs, asserted equal by lint:ledgers rather than hand-typed. The roster is THE single source for the mobile suites (#915 Wave 2): a suite's budget sits beside the flows it prices and the rung it runs on. This section exists so the budget ledger is a complete index of the repo's ceilings and so the down-only rule is enforced in one place; `node scripts/check-ledgers.mjs --write` refreshes it, and scripts/check-mobile-suite-budgets.mjs still ratchets the roster itself against the merge base.
